Attack Range expands, ASPD +100; each attack deals Physical damage equal to 200% of ATK to the target and up to 5 nearby ground enemies. Summons a Floating Exile Pod ahead, which continuously moves up to 15 nearby ground enemies with a combined Weight of at most 8 forward. The pod disappears after moving 3 tiles, leaving a whirlpool. All enemies in the whirlpool have Movement Speed -70% and take 200 Corrosion and Physical damage equal to 250% of ATK every second

Attack Range expands, attacks +2 additional targets. Each attack deals Physical damage equal to 150% of ATK and inflicts additional Corrosion equal to 20% of Physical damage dealt. Whenever any enemy on the battlefield suffers a Corrosion burst, consumes 1 ammo to deal 3 hits of Physical damage equal to 200% of ATK and Elemental Damage equal to 150% of ATK to all ground enemies on the target’s tile and the four adjacent tiles.
Skill holds 10 ammo and ends when all ammo is consumed (can be manually deactivated at any time)
